title: ThermoSwarm: analysis code for altitude-resolved storm-time thermospheric density from multi-object orbital decay
description: Python scripts that download public orbital and space-weather data, invert two-line element sets for thermospheric density against NRLMSIS 2.1, calibrate ballistic coefficients in quiet time, validate against ESA Swarm densities, test storm-time model bias and recovery, and train a physics-informed gradient-boosting drag forecaster. Accompanies the manuscript 'ThermoSwarm: Altitude-Resolved Storm-Time Thermospheric Density From Multi-Object Orbital Decay, With Physics-Informed Drag Forecasting' submitted to Space Weather.
